_comment: Which palette group each node type belongs to.
Kept out of the node_types/*.json files on purpose: those are a faithful
transcription of the source project's NODE_REGISTRY, which has no notion of
transcription still matches. A grouping of our own would break that proof.
The order and labels of the groups themselves live in option_sets.json as
nodeCategories, so a group can exist before anything is in it — which is
Membership is by exception: a node type not listed below falls into
`default`. Moving one is a single line here and no code change anywhere.
